description: A Flutter widget that provides a responsive, interactive chessboard UI with tap-to-move functionality and move highlighting, leveraging a game controller for game state management.

classes.name: ChessBoardWidget
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the chessboard UI, handling rendering, user interactions, and move highlighting.

classes.name: _ChessBoardWidgetState
classes.description: State class managing the current selection, legal move highlights, and rendering logic for the chessboard.

methods.name: _pieceGlyph
methods.description: Returns the Unicode glyph for a given chess piece, based on its color and type.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, sizing and positioning the chessboard grid.

methods.name: _buildGrid
methods.description: Constructs the 8x8 grid of squares with pieces and move highlights.

methods.name: _onTapSquare
methods.description: Handles user tap on a square, managing piece selection and move attempts.
